page.title: Policies And Settings
page.purpose: Expose the minimum policy controls needed to operate AI Gateway safely, including routing profiles, retention, privacy defaults, and smoke-test behavior.

priorities.statement: Keep policy controls explicit and reviewable instead of hidden behind provider defaults.
Make privacy and evidence-retention choices clear before they affect production routes.

states.description: Policy defaults, theme, and locale controls are visible.

claims.statement: Policy settings are exposed as a named operator region.
Theme and locale controls remain keyboard reachable.
